capabilities.title: Local service lifecycle and control plane
acceptanceCriteria: The service binds to loopback and reports health without leaking environment values.
Startup, graceful shutdown, and restart preserve accurate process and Studio connection state.
capabilities.verificationMethod: Run two workstation lifecycle cycles, verify occupied-port rejection without disturbing the listener, and test failed-start PID-record cleanup.

outstandingDefects.description: Failed startup on an occupied port now removes its own confirmed dead PID record. Recovery after a killed process, shutdown interruption, and task/staged-output preservation across restart remain unverified.

capabilities.title: Persistent project creation, inspection, and recovery
acceptanceCriteria: Project creation uses a real local template and rejects unsafe names and paths.
Project configuration and state remain recoverable after service restart.
capabilities.verificationMethod: Create a project from the template, inspect it, restart the service, update bounded settings with a revision check, corrupt and rebuild the manifest, and remove stale staging output.

outstandingDefects.description: Persistent identity, bounded settings with revision conflicts, corruption/incompatibility classification, interrupted-staging recovery, and restart persistence are implemented and locally tested; a source-bound evidence record with an independent reviewer is still required before VERIFIED.

Project creation now selects from a closed template set (base, production). The production template vendors LabKit with a per-file SHA-256 lock and repoints the Rojo tree; manifest recovery infers the template from the lock. LabKit upgrade/drift tooling for already-scaffolded projects is not implemented.

approvalRequirements: Require specific user approval before any destructive project deletion; no destructive delete workflow is currently certified.

capabilities.title: Bounded Rojo project inspection and place build
acceptanceCriteria: The Lab validates the selected default.project.json and rejects path traversal and symlinked inputs.
The pinned Rojo 7.7.1 CLI builds a snapshot of declared in-project inputs without a shell.
The operation stores source and output hashes and serves a successful artifact only by its validated ID.
capabilities.verificationMethod: Run the Rojo API integration test against the installed 7.7.1 binary, including invalid-path, option-injection, operation-record, and download checks.

outstandingDefects.description: The current build run covers three local Rojo projects, but exact executable digest, reproducibility comparison, output corruption, and independent review remain open.

capabilities.title: Safe live sync and Studio project synchronization
acceptanceCriteria: A named local sync process has bounded lifecycle and loopback-only network exposure.
A sync session is bound to a verified Studio instance and place before it can change the DataModel.
capabilities.verificationMethod: Implement a fixed Rojo serve lifecycle, then inspect the target DataModel before and after an authorized sync operation.

outstandingDefects.description: A pinned Rojo 7.7.1 serve instance reached HTTP 200 on 127.0.0.1:34872 against the disposable project, but no Rojo plugin file was present and no plugin connection appeared. No DataModel write or sync was attempted.

blockers: No Rojo Studio plugin is installed or connected, and the Lab cannot click the plugin Connect control; a human must install the matching 7.7.1 plugin, open the disposable lab-empty.rbxlx place, and connect to 127.0.0.1:34872.
approvalRequirements: Before a sync writes to Studio, bind the user approval to the exact project, source revision, Studio instance, and place.

capabilities.title: Dynamic Studio MCP tool inventory
acceptanceCriteria: The connected Studio server's actual tool names, descriptions, and bounded input schemas are surfaced.
Only the named read-only allowlist is callable through the Lab; new tools remain blocked and unclassified.
capabilities.verificationMethod: Run the MCP protocol fixture and API inventory tests, then inspect a live Studio inventory when the connector is available.

outstandingDefects.description: The fresh live 36-tool capture retains every schema and shows zero name/count drift: 7 callable, 29 blocked, 0 missing schemas. The prior record had no schema bodies, so schema-level drift is not comparable; the new digest is the baseline. Disconnect/reconnect and independent review remain open. The fixed CLIs are the only mutation surface and have no dashboard route.

capabilities.title: Studio operation risk, permission, and audit model
acceptanceCriteria: Inspection, reversible mutation, destructive mutation, upload, and publishing operations have separate risk classes.
High-impact operations require specific approval and record request, result, Studio identity, place identity, and evidence.
capabilities.verificationMethod: Review the complete operation matrix, run the adversarial approval tests, and exercise the fixed local CLI through approval, execution, Studio state transition, and audit.

outstandingDefects.description: The sealed disposable-sandbox probe exercised create, replace, two local saves with backups, one fixed image upload, marker-checked delete, and cleanup (6 operations, 18 token-free audit lines). Publishing remains intentionally out of scope; Rojo live sync is separately blocked by the absent plugin; the attached review is an automated distinct process, not a human reviewer.

blockers: Publishing has no approved tool and remains prohibited; Rojo live sync awaits a human-installed and connected Studio plugin; high-impact sandbox evidence has no human independent review.
approvalRequirements: Require operation-specific approval for DataModel mutation, destructive actions, asset upload, purchase, publishing, production settings, or live/player-data changes.

capabilities.title: Typed evidence records and acceptance reporting
acceptanceCriteria: Evidence binds result to source identity, dirty state, tool versions, scenario, timestamp, and exact Studio/place when applicable.
A capability cannot be verified from documentation, a screenshot, or an untrusted task claim alone.
capabilities.verificationMethod: Run npm run verify:evidence to validate typed source-linked records, Studio place and three-session identity, player actions, replicated-state checks, no-save closure, task-process separation, pinned reference hashes, path rejection, API listing, and overview integration; then audit source revision and independent-attestation fields.

outstandingDefects.description: The Studio session source lacks a Git revision and source-tree digest; the Lab cannot bind that historical runtime result to an exact source snapshot.
No current typed record supplies source identity, complete acceptance-criterion coverage, and a separately identified reviewer for a capability result.

capabilities.title: Versioned engine, game, and production knowledge
acceptanceCriteria: Records include provenance, applicability, platform state, dependencies, failure modes, and maturity.
Validated records are searchable and unresolved links remain visible as diagnostics.
capabilities.verificationMethod: Run schema, ingestion, duplicate, reference-integrity, provenance, freshness, filtering, and coverage tests.

outstandingDefects.description: Current records do not cover every required genre, mechanic, animation discipline, and platform capability.

capabilities.title: Open hybrid reasoning and taxonomy coverage
acceptanceCriteria: Coverage is measured at subgenre and capability level rather than by record count.
Held-out hybrid concepts expose unknowns and dependency closure without substituting a nearest fixed template.
capabilities.verificationMethod: Run explicit coverage reports and an adversarial held-out hybrid composition exercise.

outstandingDefects.description: No current project-specific coverage report or held-out hybrid composition exercise has been run; the capability is a planned gap rather than a certified fact.

blockers: LAB-INTEL-001 coverage is incomplete, so the subgenre and capability-level coverage measurement this capability describes is not yet verifiable.

capabilities.title: Specialist matching, task plans, and structured handoffs
acceptanceCriteria: Specialist selection covers required capabilities and typed inputs/outputs with a distinct reviewer.
Project task plans preserve dependencies, file ownership, knowledge snapshots, artifacts, transitions, and evidence.
capabilities.verificationMethod: Run API and store tests for match, persistence, handoff, dependency flow, transitions, output requirements, and revision conflicts.

outstandingDefects.description: The Lab creates human-directed handoffs and does not launch or authenticate an external specialist agent.

blockers: LAB-PROJECT-001 and LAB-INTEL-002 are not yet verified, so the full project creation and hybrid-coverage selection path described in this capability's acceptance criteria is not exercised end to end.

capabilities.title: Actual agent execution and independent review identity
acceptanceCriteria: A supported client consumes a task and returns real bounded artifacts to the declared project paths.
A reviewer distinct from the author can reject work and its identity is attributable to an authenticated execution surface.
capabilities.verificationMethod: Run npm run verify:task-execution for separate local MCP process claims, permission and ownership enforcement, rejection/remediation, reviewer-run Luau and Rojo checks, acceptance, and restart persistence; then verify an authenticated supported AI host against a real Lab project.

outstandingDefects.description: The test-only workflow proves distinct MCP server process/session execution and fixed local checks, but has not been exercised by a supported AI host against a real Lab project.
MCP client name/version are self-reported; the Lab does not cryptographically attest the AI provider, model, or human behind the process.

blockers: The only verified execution evidence is a test-only fixture with a self-reported client; the Lab does not attest an external AI provider, model, or human. Independent reviewer identity for this capability is therefore local process separation only, not a human/provider attestation.

capabilities.title: Reproducible original asset factory
acceptanceCriteria: Original assets rebuild from editable source with rights, tool, export, hash, and technical metadata.
Asset class, technical review, artistic review, and Studio integration state are separately recorded.
capabilities.verificationMethod: Rebuild an original asset in isolated mode, compare source-level invariants, integrate through a verified local project path, and obtain human visual review.

outstandingDefects.description: The asset factory and a no-upload Roblox mesh integration route are not yet verified.

blockers: The build artifact is an engineering export record, not a verified Studio integration or human visual review. Asset factory verification cannot be completed without an approved integration and review path.
approvalRequirements: No asset upload, purchase, or paid service without specific user authorization; preserve asset rights/provenance.

capabilities.title: Coherent visual direction and animation production
acceptanceCriteria: Shape, color, materials, lighting, UI, audio, animation, and VFX share a reviewed visual grammar.
Animation is reviewed for state timing, interruption, replication, and gameplay synchronization.
capabilities.verificationMethod: Review a coherent original scene and representative gameplay animation against a repeatable rubric and target-tier captures.

outstandingDefects.description: No project has a human-approved final art direction or certified animation set.

blockers: LAB-ASSET-001 is not verified and the referenced visual-grammar record does not include a human-approved final art direction. Art direction and animation verification cannot be completed without that review.
approvalRequirements: Final art direction and hero asset quality require human approval; generated or authored output is not self-approved.

capabilities.title: Reusable game implementation and production workflow
acceptanceCriteria: Project requirements create server-authoritative gameplay tasks and integrate original assets with explicit device targets.
A new genre can move from brief to playable experience using the same Lab workflow.
capabilities.verificationMethod: Build and play a complete original experience through the Lab workflow, including failure, recovery, multiplayer, and device scenarios.

outstandingDefects.description: The solo Echo-to-archive-to-route-to-restoration loop is evidenced by HUD captures at Restorations 1 and 3. The 2026-11-10 gate probe then observed exactly one Server player and one Client player and confirmed that the live 36-tool MCP surface exposes no player-count, start-server, or additional-client operation; two-client replication, failure/recovery, touch/controller input, and a new-genre brief-to-playable run remain unverified. The device probe used a Studio emulator only, not a physical phone.

No current typed record covers every acceptance criterion for this capability, and no independent reviewer is attached. The gate records are blocked evidence, not passing gameplay or device certification.

LabKit 1.0 (16 modules: validated Net contracts, session-locked PlayerData, idempotent Receipts, Economy, Inventory, StateMachine, Rng, LootTable, Spring, Theme, Create, Signal, Trove, Retry, RateLimiter, Schema) and the LabKit production template are implemented with Roblox-free CLI specs that passed under a Lua 5.3 translation harness on 2026-11-12. The pinned Luau 0.745 spec run, Rojo builds of the template and package, and any Studio play of the production template have not yet been recorded as evidence; a new-genre brief-to-playable run on the template remains unverified.

blockers: Two-client, physical-device, visual-approval, and independent-review gates remain. The live MCP surface starts only one Server and one Client and has no multi-client or player-count operation; the physical midrange phone is unavailable. Only a reversible local playtest CLI and the fixed Device Simulator operation are authorized; no gameplay sync or DataModel mutation is certified.
approvalRequirements: Specific user approval is required before saving changes to a live or user-owned DataModel; use an unpublished local test place.

capabilities.title: Executable test harnesses and evidence-grade reporting
acceptanceCriteria: Node, pure Luau CLI specs, Luau syntax, Luau analysis, Rojo, Studio, device, and visual results are reported as separate grades.
Pure rules specs execute under pinned Luau, while engine-dependent project specs execute in an identified Roblox Studio harness and failures cannot be hidden by a local build pass.
capabilities.verificationMethod: Run the credential-free offline suite and the dedicated Roblox rules harness in an identified unpublished Studio place.

outstandingDefects.description: Engine-dependent project .spec.luau files still need a dedicated Studio runner; Luau engine type analysis and runtime/device reporting are also open.

scripts/test-all.ps1 now runs every *.cli.spec.luau under projects/ and roblox/ with the pinned Luau 0.745 (previously specs were a separate manual command); the first hosted-CI run of this change is the verification point.

blockers: The Lab Studio bridge is connected and the solo loop is complete, but the engine-dependent Studio harness, Luau analysis, and physical-device grades remain. No independent reviewer is attached; a desktop pass is not a device or gameplay certification.

capabilities.title: Multiplayer, input, and physical device certification
acceptanceCriteria: Two real clients complete replication and recovery scenarios with server/client state agreement.
Touch/controller behavior and physical midrange-device performance are measured against recorded budgets.
capabilities.verificationMethod: Run named Studio server/client scenarios and repeat them on a physical midrange mobile device with captured logs and device identity.

outstandingDefects.description: The current Signal Garden solo loop is complete with three restorations, but historical two-client evidence remains scenario-limited. The 2026-11-10 local probe observed exactly one Server player and one Client player and no multi-client operation in 36 tools; it did not run two clients or abuse/replication scenarios. Studio Device Simulator selection and a viewport capture were recorded, but no physical phone, touch hardware, or target-device profile was used.

blockers: STUDIO_MULTI_CLIENT_SURFACE_ABSENT: the live MCP start_stop_play schema accepts only is_start and studio_id, and the 36-tool surface has no player-count, start-server, or additional-client operation. PHYSICAL_MIDRANGE_DEVICE_UNAVAILABLE: no physical phone is available, and a Studio emulator is not a substitute. A human must drive Studio's native Clients and Servers UI (or another supported multi-client runner) and attach a named midrange phone with touch and 10-15 minute profile evidence.

capabilities.title: Runtime performance and memory certification
acceptanceCriteria: Frame time, memory, network, load time, and graphics quality are measured on representative target hardware.
Quality tiers preserve essential silhouette, readability, and gameplay while meeting recorded budgets.
capabilities.verificationMethod: Profile named workloads in Roblox Studio and on a physical midrange device; record device, settings, source digest, and measured values.

outstandingDefects.description: A single local Studio development sample is recorded, but it is skewed by the high-end laptop and Studio overhead. The 2026-11-10 Device Simulator probe selected samsung_galaxy_s25_ultra at 685x338 and captured a viewport, but it collected no frame-time, memory, load, network, thermal, or quality-tier measurements. No target-device profile or validated quality tiers exist.

blockers: No representative physical midrange mobile device is available for device-side frame, memory, and thermal profiling. Studio Device Simulator only confirms the emulator surface; it is not target-device performance certification.

capabilities.title: Independent security and exploit-resistance review
acceptanceCriteria: Local file, origin, process, and Studio permission boundaries withstand adversarial tests.
Server-authoritative gameplay rejects malformed, unauthorized, out-of-range, and rate-abusive client requests.
capabilities.verificationMethod: Perform code review and adversarial API/gameplay abuse tests; separate static heuristics from a security pass.

outstandingDefects.description: No independent full-platform security audit or complete multiplayer abuse certification has been recorded. The gate probe only recorded one Server player and one Client player and the absence of a multi-client operation; it did not send malformed, unauthorized, out-of-range, stale-state, or rate-abusive requests.

blockers: LAB-GAME-001, LAB-QA-001, and LAB-STUDIO-002 are not verified. The live 36-tool Studio surface cannot drive two clients, so server-authoritative multiplayer abuse and replication testing remain blocked; no security claim is made from the single-client probe.

capabilities.title: Player research, ethical product design, and live operations
acceptanceCriteria: Audience hypotheses are tested with real players and outcomes inform design decisions.
Telemetry, privacy, retention, economy ethics, support, and release operations are documented and measured only with authorization.
capabilities.verificationMethod: Run an approved player research protocol and record observations, privacy limits, and stop/continue criteria.

outstandingDefects.description: No approved player research protocol, telemetry, or live-ops measurement exists; the capability is a planned gap.

blockers: LAB-GAME-001, LAB-INTEL-002, and LAB-SEC-001 are not verified; player research and live-ops certification cannot proceed without an approved concept and security baseline.
approvalRequirements: Obtain human approval and participant consent before player research; do not collect player data without explicit authorization.

capabilities.title: Independent benchmark library and flagship experience
acceptanceCriteria: Eight compact benchmark scenarios reproduce from clean source and carry scenario-specific evidence.
A separate audience-tested flagship passes unpublished release-candidate review.
capabilities.verificationMethod: Rebuild and execute each benchmark scenario; independently inspect the held-out hybrid and final flagship evidence.

outstandingDefects.description: Eight benchmark source projects exist and build, but none has source-bound scenario execution, target-device or visual evidence, and independent certification. The separate flagship candidate is not audited or audience-tested.

blockers: Benchmark runtime, device, visual, and independent-review gates remain. The flagship requires human visual approval and participant evidence; no benchmark may be promoted from a local build alone.
approvalRequirements: Flagship final art and audience-test outcomes require human review; no publishing or paid asset use without specific authorization.

capabilities.title: Continuous integration and reproducible packaging
acceptanceCriteria: Approved CI runs the same offline checks and retains artifact/source digests.
An offline portable release candidate can be reproduced and unpacked without cloud credentials.
capabilities.verificationMethod: Run the hosted workflow after an authorized push; verify the offline package and clean extraction locally.

outstandingDefects.description: Hosted Windows runs have passed on 9b9836d and 546754d, but no independent review is attached and the release dossier has not archived the current artifact identity.

approvalRequirements: Obtain explicit user authorization to push this branch to the existing GitHub origin before triggering or claiming the hosted workflow.

capabilities.title: Local backup, restore, and recovery evidence
acceptanceCriteria: A bounded archive includes all required source roots and excludes local runtime and secrets.
Restore verifies safe entry paths and source hashes without overwriting the active workspace.
capabilities.verificationMethod: Create a fresh archive, restore to a unique temporary directory, and compare the included file/hash manifest.

outstandingDefects.description: Fresh restore and tamper/path rejection pass. Interrupted operations, backup to a separate device, content-level secret screening, off-device recovery, and independent review remain unverified.

approvalRequirements: Obtain a named, authorized destination before copying backups off-device.

capabilities.title: Unpublished release-candidate certification
acceptanceCriteria: The final unpublished experience passes gameplay, device, visual, security, performance, rights, recovery, and independent review gates.
All acceptance-register entries are verified or remain explicitly blocked with evidence and owner approvals.
capabilities.verificationMethod: Run the full release checklist against an identified unpublished candidate and have an independent reviewer sign the evidence record.
approvalRequirements: Require a human release review and specific authorization for any publish, upload, purchase, monetization, or production data operation.
